insight: Acquired by Workday in August 2025 to power its enterprise AI-agent builder; the open-source core continues.
name: Flowise
tagline: Visually build AI agents and LLM workflows — drag-and-drop, self-hosted.
description: A low-code visual builder for AI agents, chatflows, and multi-agent systems on a node canvas. It self-hosts locally through npm or Docker, or deploys to major clouds, and is provider-agnostic across many LLMs via its node ecosystem. The core is Apache-2.0; a managed Flowise Cloud tier exists, making it freemium.

modelSupport.notes: Provider-agnostic via LangChain/LlamaIndex nodes; exact set depends on installed nodes.

edge: Drag-and-drop counterpart to code-first frameworks — builds on LangChain/LlamaIndex nodes, self-hosts via npm/Docker.
cons: Cloud tier is a separate paid product

changelog.summary: Insight updated to note Workday's August 2025 acquisition of Flowise; open-source Apache-2.0 core continues.
